run_simulator_with_audio_sensor: run a habitat_sim simulator with an audio sensor configured for mono audio propagation
configure_simulator_backend: configure a habitat_sim simulator backend with a semantic mesh scene and disabled physics
add_audio_sensor_to_agent: add a mono audio sensor with acoustics configuration to a habitat_sim agent
set_audio_source_transform: set the audio source transform position for a habitat_sim audio sensor
capture_and_write_audio_observation: capture audio sensor observations and write them to a WAV file
